channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2026-18577 — N-able N-central
item.description: Threat Signal 71. N-able N-central contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel allows for authentication bypass and account takeover in N-central. This vulnerability is the result of an incomplete patch for CVE-2026-18556.

item.title: CVE-2026-48027 — Nx Nx Console
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Nx Console contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability that allowed a malicious version of Nx Console to be published. The compromised extension fetched an obfuscated payload that could harvested credentials from multiple sources on disk and in memory.

item.title: CVE-2026-45321 — TanStack TanStack
item.description: Threat Signal 71. TanStack contains an unspecified vulnerability that allowed malicious versions of the product to be published to the npm registry to publish credential-stealing malware under a trusted identity.

item.title: CVE-2019-9621 — Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS)
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability via the ProxyServlet component.

item.title: CVE-2025-42999 — SAP NetWeaver
item.description: Threat Signal 71. SAP NetWeaver Visual Composer Metadata Uploader contains a deserialization vulnerability that allows a privileged attacker to compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the host system by deserializing untrusted or malicious content.

item.title: CVE-2025-30066 — tj-actions changed-files GitHub Action
item.description: Threat Signal 71. tj-actions/changed-files GitHub Action contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to discover secrets by reading Github Actions Workflow Logs. These secrets may include, but are not limited to, valid AWS access keys, GitHub personal access tokens (PATs), npm tokens, and private RSA keys.

item.title: CVE-2020-29574 — Sophos CyberoamOS
item.description: Threat Signal 71. CyberoamOS (CROS) contains a SQL injection vulnerability in the WebAdmin that allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary SQL statements remotely.

item.title: CVE-2018-9276 — Paessler PRTG Network Monitor
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Paessler PRTG Network Monitor contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows an attacker with administrative privileges to execute commands via the PRTG System Administrator web console.

item.title: CVE-2024-11667 — Zyxel Multiple Firewalls
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Multiple Zyxel firewalls contain a path traversal vulnerability in the web management interface that could allow an attacker to download or upload files via a crafted URL.

item.title: CVE-2024-38812 — VMware vCenter Server
item.description: Threat Signal 71. VMware vCenter Server contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the implementation of the DCERPC protocol. This vulnerability could allow an attacker with network access to the vCenter Server to execute remote code by sending a specially crafted packet.

item.title: CVE-2021-26086 — Atlassian Jira Server and Data Center
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Atlassian Jira Server and Data Center contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to read particular files in the /WEB-INF/web.xml endpoint.

item.title: CVE-2024-49039 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Microsoft Windows Task Scheduler contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that can allow an attacker-provided, local application to escalate privileges outside of its AppContainer, and access privileged RPC functions.

item.title: CVE-2023-45249 — Acronis Cyber Infrastructure (ACI)
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Acronis Cyber Infrastructure (ACI) allows an unauthenticated user to execute commands remotely due to the use of default passwords.

item.title: CVE-2024-20353 — Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD)
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) contain an infinite loop vulnerability that can lead to remote denial of service condition.

item.title: CVE-2018-15133 — Laravel Laravel Framework
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Laravel Framework contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability, allowing for remote command execution. This vulnerability may only be exploited if a malicious user has accessed the application encryption key (APP_KEY environment variable).

item.title: CVE-2023-23752 — Joomla! Joomla!
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Joomla! contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows unauthorized access to webservice endpoints.

item.title: CVE-2023-49103 — ownCloud ownCloud graphapi
item.description: Threat Signal 71. ownCloud graphapi contains an information disclosure vulnerability that can reveal sensitive data stored in phpinfo() via GetPhpInfo.php, including administrative credentials.

item.title: CVE-2022-26501 — Veeam Backup & Replication
item.description: Threat Signal 71. The Veeam Distribution Service in the Backup & Replication application allows unauthenticated users to access internal API functions. A remote attacker can send input to the internal API which may lead to uploading and executing of malicious code.

item.title: CVE-2021-38406 — Delta Electronics DOPSoft 2
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Delta Electronics DOPSoft 2 lacks proper validation of user-supplied data when parsing specific project files (improper input validation) resulting in an out-of-bounds write that allows for code execution.

item.title: CVE-2010-2883 — Adobe Acrobat and Reader
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Adobe Acrobat and Reader contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code or cause denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2016-7256 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 71. A remote code execution vulnerability exists when the Windows font library improperly handles specially crafted embedded fonts. An attacker who successfully exploits this vulnerability could take control of the affected system.

item.title: CVE-2015-0016 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Directory traversal vulnerability in the TS WebProxy (TSWbPrxy) component in Microsoft Windows allows remote attackers to escalate privileges.

item.title: CVE-2016-4657 — Apple iOS
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Apple iOS WebKit contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows attackers to execute remote code or cause a denial-of-service (DoS) via a crafted web site. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2019-11708 — Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird contain a sandbox escape vulnerability that could result in remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2020-2021 — Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a vulnerability in SAML which allows an attacker to bypass authentication.

item.title: CVE-2018-0125 — Cisco VPN Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 71. A vulnerability in the web interface of the Cisco VPN Routers could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary code as root and gain full control of an affected system.

item.title: CVE-2015-4068 — Arcserve Unified Data Protection (UDP)
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Directory traversal vulnerability in Arcserve UDP allows remote attackers to obtain sensitive information or cause a denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2016-5195 — Linux Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Race condition in mm/gup.c in the Linux kernel allows local users to escalate privileges.

item.title: CVE-2014-6352 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Microsoft Windows allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted OLE object.

item.title: CVE-2014-1761 — Microsoft Word
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Microsoft Word contains a memory corruption vulnerability which when exploited could allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2019-0193 — Apache Solr
item.description: Threat Signal 71. The optional Apache Solr module DataImportHandler contains a code injection vulnerability.

item.title: CVE-2021-27101 — Accellion FTA
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Accellion FTA contains a SQL injection vulnerability exploited via a crafted host header in a request to document_root.html.

item.title: CVE-2021-30860 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS CoreGraphics contain an integer overflow vulnerability which may allow code execution when processing a maliciously crafted PDF. The vulnerability is also known under the moniker of FORCEDENTRY.

item.title: CVE-2019-13608 — Citrix StoreFront Server
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Citrix StoreFront Server contains an XML External Entity (XXE) processing vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to retrieve potentially sensitive information.

item.title: CVE-2020-8193 — Citrix Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Gateway, and SD-WAN WANOP Appliance
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Citrix ADC, Citrix Gateway, and multiple Citrix SD-WAN WANOP appliance models contain an authorization bypass vulnerability that may allow unauthenticated access to certain URL endpoints. The attacker must have access to the NetScaler IP (NSIP) in order to perform exploitation.

item.title: CVE-2020-29557 — D-Link DIR-825 R1 Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 71. D-Link DIR-825 R1 devices contain a buffer overflow vulnerability in the web interface that may allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-30632 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2021-30551 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2020-1020 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Microsoft Windows Adobe Font Manager Library contains an unspecified vulnerability when handling specially crafted multi-master fonts (Adobe Type 1 PostScript format) that allows for remote code execution for all systems except Windows 10. For systems running Windows 10, an attacker who successfully exploited the vulnerability could execute code in an AppContainer sandbox context with limited privileges and capabilities.

item.title: CVE-2020-0968 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability due to how the Scripting Engine handles objects in memory, leading to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2020-26919 — NETGEAR JGS516PE Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Netgear JGS516PE devices contain a missing function level access control vulnerability.

item.title: CVE-2026-76460 — Cisco Identity Services Engine
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) contain an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to the affected device by bypassing the web-based management interface.

item.title: CVE-2026-76461 — Cisco Secure Email Gateway
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Cisco AsyncOS software for Cisco Secure Email Gateway (SEG) contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system.

item.title: CVE-2026-15410 — SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances
item.description: Threat Signal 70. SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contain a code injection vulnerability which in specific conditions could potentially enable a remote authenticated attacker as administrator to execute arbitrary OS commands.

item.title: CVE-2026-56290 — Joomlack Page Builder
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Joomlack Page Builder contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution via unauthenticated arbitrary file upload.

item.title: CVE-2009-1537 — Microsoft DirectX
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Microsoft DirectX contains a NULL byte overwrite vulnerability in the QuickTime Movie Parser Filter in quartz.dll in DirectShow which could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted QuickTime media file.

item.title: CVE-2026-45498 — Microsoft Defender
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Microsoft Defender contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2025-68645 — Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS)
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a PHP remote file inclusion vulnerability that could allow for remote attackers to craft requests to the /h/rest endpoint to influence internal request dispatching, allowing inclusion of arbitrary files from the WebRoot directory.

item.title: CVE-2025-32463 — Sudo Sudo
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Sudo contains an inclusion of functionality from untrusted control sphere vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow local attacker to leverage sudo’s -R (--chroot) option to run arbitrary commands as root, even if they are not listed in the sudoers file.

item.title: CVE-2025-26633 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Microsoft Windows Management Console (MMC) contains an improper neutralization vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature locally.
